summary: V495 lets a Null-consensus subnet run up to 16 mechanisms: MaxAllowedUids may be up to 2500 for any mechanism count, while Yuma keeps its limit of 256 for max UIDs times mechanism count. The global mechanism maximum stays at two until root raises it. A new Null weight row holds at most 2500 divided by the mechanism count entries; the new error is TooManyWeightsForNullMechanism. The Null epoch reads subnet-wide state once, with identical results, and adds an interim weight to the block hook. New gamma emission deposits have no daily spend cap. claim_root_with_hotkey declares weight for the validator's own fund and admits 258 claim units, so a subnet limit of 256 is safe for claims; it fails with RootClaimTooHeavy when a swap_basket buy or a hotkey swap gave that fund a new row in the same transaction. One storage item is new: BasketRowsOpenedAt. Spec version 495 with transaction version 2 requires a metadata refresh. The release guide covers releases 494 and 495.
